title: A wolf at the fire
text: A lone wolf circles the camp at dusk, drawn by the smell of the store. The hunters are away.

options.text: Drive it off with a burning branch.
options.note: {hero} drove a wolf from the fire with a burning branch, and {other} saw it.

options.text: Wake the elders and stay behind them.
options.note: {hero} woke {other} when a wolf came to the fire.

options.text: Throw it a share of the store.
options.note: {hero} bought off a hungry wolf with the clan's food, and {other} did not approve.
